name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task says 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off', but the candidate has only Existence(at_exit) hard; the compiled machine reaches u1 and pays its reward as soon as at_exit happens, with no clause tracking the siren at all, so the whole 'whenever' rule is an omission. Add a hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled): on every step the siren rings, a toggle is owed at or after it, so the siren must be silenced by the end of the episode (siren_ringing is a lasting condition and switch_toggled a one-step event, which is the right shape here). Keep Existence(at_exit) hard; no Existence is wanted for siren_ringing or switch_toggled, since the ringing is only a 'whenever' condition and the toggle is a consequent, not a goal.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) hard captures the command 'Go to the exit', and Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard captures 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' — siren_ringing is a lasting condition that only the switch toggle ends, so each ringing period closes exactly when the agent toggles, and a second start creates a new obligation. Both clauses trace to the task, priorities are hard (no preference cue), and the machine's FINAL_STATES u2 requires the exit with no pending toggle.
